title: associate walk
description: Artifact A of a run (issue #4): an ordered log of every tool call and its result, written by the harness from tool events and never editable by the model. On disk it is walk.jsonl — one $defs/entry per line, interleaved {"gate": <$defs/gate>} and {"child": <$defs/child>} lines, then a final line {"run": <$defs/run>}. This top-level document schema describes the same walk assembled in memory.

id.description: Stable walk id, monotonically increasing from w1 within a run.

error.description: Present only when the call failed.

gate.description: One safety-gate decision taken before a mutating tool call (gate.json). Decisions are recorded, never silent.

gated_tool.description: The mutating tool the gate was asked about.

gated_id.description: Walk id of the gated call, when it was recorded.

probabilities.description: clef tier only: question key to P(yes), or option to probability for a choice question.

verdict.description: super tier only: the parsed JSON answer.

child.description: A link from a parent walk to the walk of a subagent it spawned.

result.description: Either the returned content, or its digest and size when the content is too large to inline.

run.description: The final run record: reliability is observable (issue #1).
